name: nav-link
description: One point of navigation. The three surfaces styled these three ways; the active treatment was different on each.

reducedMotion.$description: Motion removed, state kept. The declaration is per unit because a blanket `animation:none` can hide content that only an entrance animation reveals.

a11y.note:
The current page carries `aria-current="page"`, never `aria-selected` — that belongs to a tab or an option, and on an `<a>` it is invalid ARIA that axe rejects. It is also never marked by colour alone: the current item changes weight and carries a marker, because a tint is the first thing lost on a dim screen or in forced-colors mode.

The whole row is the target, not the words in it — a nav item you have to hit the text of is one that misses on a trackpad, and it is how a 24px target requirement gets met on paper and failed in practice.
